name: isMissedScheduledBackupAutoResumeEnabled
definition: Every IDrive backup plan has schedule_info.start_missed_backup true, so a missed scheduled backup resumes automatically.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: at least one plan, and every plan has start_missed_backup true

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the key stops being grandfathered by the allowlist; proposed, single emitter, definition taken from the emitting transform.

notes: The file returns False, not null, when the plan list is empty.
